toolbar.logs: Tab that switches the preview pane to the compiler log output
toolbar.failed: Compile result badge, shown instead of an elapsed time when the build failed
toolbar.duration: Elapsed compile time in seconds, shown next to the compile result icon

pages.ofTotal: Follows a page-number input field: [3] of 12
pages.number: Accessible name of the page-number input field

zoom.reset: Sets the zoom back to 100 percent, it does not reset the document

outline.open: Toolbar button that opens the PDF bookmark tree, not a document format
outline.externalBadge: Badge on an outline entry whose target is a web address, not an internal page

viewer.retry: Reloads the PDF in the viewer, it does not recompile the project
viewer.retainedFailureDetail: Stands in for a missing viewer diagnostic, so it has no final period and is followed by another sentence

actions.readerView: Turns on a text-first rendering of the PDF for screen readers
actions.invert: Inverts the rendered colors of the PDF, a dark mode for the document
actions.retryCompile: Starts a new compile after a failed one

stale.badge: Short badge over the document meaning the PDF is older than the editor content

save.namePlaceholder: Example file name shown in an empty input, keep a plausible name for the locale
save.title: Heading of the dialog that writes the PDF into the project folder

download.pngFilter: File type name shown in the operating system save dialog

status.done: One-word status of a startup step that finished
status.running: One-word status of a startup step in progress
status.queued: One-word status of a startup step that has not begun
status.skipped: One-word status of a startup step that does not apply
status.failed: One-word status of a startup step that errored

startup.doneCount: Compact counter in the startup panel, for example 2/3 done
startup.metaRunning: Count of startup steps currently running
startup.metaQueued: Count of startup steps waiting to start
startup.metaFailed: Count of startup steps that failed
startup.orPress: Follows a Compile now button, the tag wraps the keyboard shortcut

language.ready: Detail line meaning the language service has finished starting

window.staleUnknownRevision: Stands in for a project revision number that is not known
window.staleCompileFailedDetail: Stands in for a missing compiler message, so it has no final period and is followed by another sentence
window.fitWidth: Zooms the page so its width fills the window
window.fitHeight: Zooms the page so its height fills the window
window.invert: Inverts the rendered colors of the PDF, a dark mode for the document

outline.untitled: Stands in for a PDF bookmark that carries no title text
outline.noDestination: Tooltip on a PDF bookmark that points nowhere, so it cannot be opened

status.loading: Progress message while the compiled PDF is being opened in the viewer
